notes: Every numeric value is {low, mid, high, sources}. 'mid' = recommended engine default; 'high' = hard ceiling (never exceed without explicit override). Source keys resolve in the 'sources' map at the bottom. Values tagged 'extrapolation' or 'heuristic' in the source list are engine-design judgments, not directly measured thresholds. Not medical advice; requires professional review.

weekly_volume_increase_frac._basis: Fractional increase of weekly volume (distance or time) vs the mean of the previous 2 weeks.

aerobic_session_duration_step_min._basis: Absolute per-session duration increase allowed every 1-2 weeks during the first 4-6 weeks; also serves as the minimum step for low baselines.

resistance_load_increase_frac._basis: Load step when the user exceeds target reps by 1-2 on 2 consecutive sessions.

single_session_spike_cap_frac._basis: Max fractional excess of a single session over the longest comparable session in the last 30 days. Applies to distance/duration, to elevation gain for hikes, and to the boss battle.

acwr_band._basis: SECONDARY guardrail only; not a validated injury predictor. Compute uncoupled (acute 7 d / mean of prior 21-28 d excluding current week) on session-RPE load. Never use to justify breaking the weekly or single-session caps.

monotony_guard_max_consecutive_similar_d._basis: Days in a row with session-RPE load within +/-10% of each other (engine heuristic derived from Foster's monotony concept).

block_length_weeks._basis: Consecutive build weeks before a deload.

plan_templates._note: B = build week, D = deload, T = taper/boss week. Descriptive templates; weeks not numeric caps.
plan_templates.6_weeks: B B B B D(optional for novices) T
plan_templates.8_weeks: B B B D B B B T
plan_templates.10_weeks: B B B D B B B D B T
plan_templates.12_weeks: B B B D B B B D B B T T
